memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths; and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth. Include one male goat to make atonement for you. Offer these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect. - Num 28:28-31 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter closes as it has run throughout, with careful instructions for offerings, including a goat to make atonement, all brought in addition to the regular daily offering. And once more we read that the animals were to be "without defect." Only the best and unblemished could be offered to God. Nothing flawed or second-rate was fit for the Lord.

This repeated requirement, that offerings be without defect, points to a profound truth. God is worthy of the very best, and the sacrifice for sin had to be perfect. A flawed offering could not represent a spotless substitute. The unblemished animals whispered of a coming sacrifice that would be truly perfect in every way.

That perfect sacrifice is Christ. He was the Lamb without blemish or defect, sinless and spotless, the only offering fully worthy to take away sin (1 Pet 1:19). Every unblemished animal in Israel's worship pointed forward to Him. What the law required but no animal could ultimately supply, Christ perfectly fulfilled.

As we come to the end of this calendar of offerings, we can lift our eyes to Jesus with gratitude. The daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly sacrifices all found their meaning in Him. We no longer bring offerings for sin, for the perfect offering has been made. Rest in Christ, the spotless Lamb, whose one sacrifice covers every season of your life.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you offer God your best, recognising He is worthy of it?
2. How do the unblemished offerings point you to Christ, the spotless Lamb?
3. What does it mean to rest in the one perfect sacrifice for all your life?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, You are the spotless Lamb, without blemish or defect, whose one sacrifice covers every season of my life. Thank You that in You the perfect offering has been made. I rest in Your finished work. Amen.
